items.title: August Lanoix Interview, 1961-04-19
items.q: That's Louis's brother. He looks sort of like Louis.

ctx.x: On there. Now that is, see that trombone? Yes. That's Louis. Is that Louis Anchant's brother? The trombone player? Is that his brother? I don't remember. Yeah, that's his brother. His brother. He had a brother playing trombone. That's Louis's brother. He looks sort of like Louis. That's Louis's brother.
I didn't know much about his brother though.
